sections.title: Project Green Gold
sections.html:
Project Green Gold

By Keshav Srushti

Keshav Srushti's Gram Vikas Yojana is actively involved in making villages “Self-Sustainable” through its broad initiatives under verticals like Education, Health, Agriculture and Industry.

In year 2017, once Indian Forest Act was amended to remove “Bamboo” from Tree category and bring it under Grass category, it opened a huge potential for Tribal communities for sustainable living through Bamboo cultivation and Harvesting.

Keshav Srushti in its pursuit to develop sustainable living for Tribal communities in Vikramgad Taluka (District: Palghar), found an innovative idea to build a business model around Bamboo crop which would be Environment Friendly, Self Sustaining and Empowering the village communities especially the Tribal Women. This initiative was named “Project Green Gold”.

Under this initiative, Keshav Srushti started training of 25 Women in Tetawali Village in Jan 2019 to make Handicraft related products from Bamboo. In view of the encouraging response and the hardwork of Keshav Srushti's Team, a company was registered by name “Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Ltd” which is 100% owned and managed by Tribal Artisans.

As of March 2024, the company has 253 shareholders (mainly Tribal Women) and giving employment to more than 800+ Tribal Women.

SUPPORTED BY NABARD • AN INITIATIVE OF KESHAV SRUSHTI

The Artisan's Touch & Heritage

Every piece is meticulously handcrafted by tribal women artisans belonging to the Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited. Harvested from local mature bamboo thickets in the rural forests of Palghar, each bamboo culm is seasoned, precision-cut, and manually lathed using time-honored tribal craftsmanship techniques passed down through generations.

By eliminating synthetic industrial resins and plastics, we preserve the natural grain, warmth, and strength of sustainable Indian bamboo while ensuring ethical wages and dignity of labor for our rural producers.

🤝
Empowering Tribal Women in 25+ Palghar Villages

Bamboo First operates in direct partnership with NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) and Keshav Srushti to foster women's micro-enterprises and village self-reliance.

Technical Specifications

Primary Material 100% Solid Natural Bamboo (Bambusa tulda / Dendrocalamus strictus)
Dimensions (L x B x H) Large Diamond Frame (Non-Foldable)
Surface Finish Non-toxic Herbal Oil Polish / Water-Resistant Food-Safe Seal
Production Method Handcrafted & Lathed by Tribal Artisans
Place of Origin Vikramgad, Palghar District, Maharashtra, India
Manufacturer / Producer Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited (Supported by NABARD & Keshav Srushti)
Eco Characteristics 100% Biodegradable, Carbon-Negative, Plastic-Free

Care & Longevity Guide

• Cleaning: Wipe gently with a soft damp cotton cloth. Avoid submerging in standing water or commercial dishwashers.

• Drying: Ensure the product is thoroughly air-dried in a shaded, well-ventilated spot if exposed to rain or moisture.

• Longevity Polish: Apply a light dab of pure coconut oil, linseed oil, or mineral oil once every 3-4 months to restore its glowing natural bamboo luster.

• End of Life: 100% compostable and biodegradable at the end of its multi-year lifespan, returning cleanly to Mother Earth.

Eco-Conscious Packaging & Safe Transit

• Zero Plastic Cushioning: We wrap every bamboo creation in biodegradable honeycomb kraft paper and natural jute cord.

• Crush-Tested Outer Box: Packed in double-walled corrugated shipping cartons designed to endure long transit without bending.

• Dispatch Timeline: Handcrafted orders are carefully inspected and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours directly from Vikramgad, Palghar.

• Replacement Guarantee: In the rare event of transit damage, we provide a no-questions-asked 7-day replacement.

sections.title: Who we are?
sections.html:
Who we are?

Welcome to the world of sustainable tourism presented by “Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited”. VBUPCL is a Producer Company supported by NABARD for bamboo craft artisans of Vikramgad block in Palghar district. It is an extension of social initiative “Project Green Gold” led by Keshav Srushti since 2019 for skilling & entrepreneurship development of tribal women. Employment, Empowerment & Environment has been the core of the project. Hundreds of tribal lives have been transformed since then & Bamboo Ecotourism has been the essential part of the successful journey.

What we do?

We aim to create sustainable entrepreneurship opportunities for tribal communities through bamboo, with a special focus on empowering women, all while prioritising the protection of the environment. We have built a bridge to connect urban people with rural way of sustainable living that strives to preserve nature, culture, art, values, and tradition of India.

What you get?

Immerse yourself in a range of activities that connect you with the heart of village life. Witness various organic farm produce as per the season, enjoy the lush green nature during monsoons, and listen to captivating stories narrated by water bodies. Get hands-on experience in making bamboo crafts, Warli art, and much more. Live a day without gadgets and embrace a more human experience. Bring your family, cheerfulness over materialism.

sections.title: Experience eco life first hand
sections.html:
Experience eco life first hand

Your visit will be with a traditional welcome amid rangolis featuring the tribal tarpa dance and chiming lezims followed by a cup of refreshing black tea. Discover bamboo handicrafts first hand in a  hands on workshop with the master artisan. Savour your tastebuds with early lunch of organic foods. Get going on a guided walk to visit the local farms, river streams, ponds and historical places. Spark your fine arts with an exclusive Warli art workshop. Immerse yourself in the tribal cultural traditions as you join the rhythm for a round of folk dance of Gauri nritya. Explore the bamboo handicrafts stall to shop for affordable sustainable products for your lifestyle or home decor or celebrations. End your day with a candid one on one chat with the villagers as you take home memories of a lifetime.

sections.title: Our Story
sections.html:
Our Story

Bamboo has long been a symbol of resilience, positivity, and strength—qualities that resonate deeply with humanity’s journey. This remarkable plant, revered for its 1500+ documented uses, has the potential to transform lives and communities, as envisioned by our visionary former Prime Minister, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

In 2004, at the seventh World Bamboo Congress in New Delhi, he foresaw bamboo’s incredible economic value, predicting its ability to lift millions out of poverty and contribute significantly to India’s economy. His words planted the seeds of a movement that would take shape years later.

In 2014, another visionary leader, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, reignited the call for atmanirbharta (self-reliance). Meanwhile, our mentor organization, Keshav Srushti, was tirelessly working on rural development through initiatives like solar-powered irrigation under the Keshav Srushti Gram Vikas Yojana (KSGVY).

By 2017, KSGVY turned PM Vajpayee’s prophetic vision into action with Project Green Gold. This initiative trained underprivileged tribal women from five villages in Wada taluka in the art of bamboo handicrafts, offering them a sustainable livelihood beyond farming. After three years of rigorous development, the community launched its first product—the bamboo rakhi.

This newfound empowerment bore fruit even during the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic. Villages in Palghar district delivered over 50,000 bamboo rakhis in 2020 and over 8,000 bamboo lanterns (kandeels) in subsequent years. The product range expanded to 100+ creations, spanning festive, devotional, home, lifestyle, and gifting categories. A milestone came when the community successfully fulfilled an international order of 500 bamboo auto rickshaws for the UK, showcasing their design capabilities.

In 2023, on Gudi Padwa, the Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited was formally registered—India’s first tribal women-led rural agri-startup. Shortly after, Bamboo First was launched, introducing the world to our unique e-commerce platform of bamboo products crafted with care and purpose.

Today, Bamboo First stands as a testament to the strength of community, the power of sustainability, and the spirit of tribal women who are building a self-reliant future. Through every product we create, we celebrate a journey rooted in tradition and growing towards empowerment.

sections.title: Our Team
sections.html:
Our Team

We are a team of proud Indians with roots in the tribal traditions of the Dongri-Vikramgad region of Palghar district in the state of Maharashtra (India). Our team comprises 600+ artisans from over 25 villages of the Palghar district founded with investments of 300+ individuals from the tribal community, 90% of which are women.

We are thankful to our mentors Keshav Srushti for cultivating leadership from within our community that is empowered to lead The Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Co. Ltd. today.

We thank our finance mentors NABARD that have facilitated the formation of our OFPO, The Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Co. Ltd. and backed us with funding for our operations. Meet the team that leads our aspirations of Atmanirbharta in the Amritkaal of democracy.

sections.title: OUR 5 YEAR JOURNEY
sections.html:
OUR 5 YEAR JOURNEY

In just five years, Bamboo First has grown from a simple vision of sustainability to a thriving movement redefining eco-conscious living. With innovative bamboo products, from toothbrushes to home decor, we've inspired greener choices while partnering with local farmers, supporting reforestation, and raising awareness about bamboo's environmental benefits.

This journey, fueled by our amazing customers and partners, has proven that sustainability is more than a trend—it's a path to a better future. As we celebrate this milestone, we thank you for being part of our story and look forward to shaping greener horizons together.

sections.title: Mentors Guiding Vision
sections.html:
We are blessed to be in the lap of the Bharat mata where numerous great men have been born in every era and guided society towards the path of progress and development. Two such visionaries of contemporary times Former PM Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee ji and our current PM Shri Narendra Modi ji presented a unique vision for marginalized sections of the society like ours.

Our mentors HDFC Life, Cactus Communications Pvt Ltd, Young volunteers organisation, gem & jewellery national relief foundation and Keshav Srushti have been instrumental in driving this vision to change on ground, shaping us from an ordinary rural community to the present Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Co. Pvt. Ltd.

23rd Nov 2023

Bhoomi Poojan’ ceremony for
CFC construction at Balkapra village

Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producers Company Ltd (VBUPCL) and Keshav Srushti have planned the Bhoomi Poojan ceremony of their common facility centre at the Balkapra Village in Jawahar block on Thursday, 23rd November at 10:30 am.

This facility is committed to empowering tribal communities by providing bamboo-centric skill training, processing, showcasing, and marketing for bamboo crafts curated by tribal women. It is situated within a dense bamboo plantation consisting of 5,500 bamboos of various species spanning across 15 acres of land.

15th Oct 2024

Bamboo plantation
experts Ajay Doke and Salim Sayyad visit Tetwali

Salim Sayyed ji and Ajay Dolke ji visit our Balkapra bamboo plantation to share their expertise in bamboo forestry. It was a day long discussion with lot of learning and revelations. Our day ended at Tetwali visit in the presence of Bimal ji with a brief talk.

Both have worked closely with Sunil Deshpande ji hence they felt our work is a good reflection of his vision in bamboo sector.

sections.title: Mann Ki Baat Feature Video
sections.html:
Hon'ble PM Narendra Modi - Mann ki baat Episode 96

Hon. Prime Minister of Bharat Shri. Narendra Modi mentioned about our effort in 96th 'Mann ki Baat' through a one-minute video of our tribal women artisans making bamboo articles. Sustainability is the buzzword all over the world and the answer lies in being close to the nature. 'Bamboo First' is providing effective solutions with bamboo as a medium to fight climate change & empower the tribal communities with employment at the same time. Sooner or later, we all need to switch to eco-friendly living so that our coming generations live happily. Lets start here & now.

sections.title: Lessons From Bamboo
sections.html:
Lessons From Bamboo

Bamboo imparts many lessons, one of them is to live for others. Working with bamboo to serve the underserved is divine. Anything that is divine will test your patience before showing results. Keshav Srushti's bamboo project is the story of test of times & how every stone was carved into milestone with patience & grit. One of the chapters is the bamboo plantation effort.

sections.title: Planting In Difficult Terrain
sections.html:
Planting In Difficult Terrain

When we decided to plant bamboo in difficult terrain of Jawhar block in 2020-21, we were told to rethink. We took the risk & planted some beautiful species like Bambusa Polymarpha & Dandrocalamus Longispathus. Filled with lessons of resilience, today acres of Bamboo plantation (Oxygen Park) is glowing green.

sections.title: Vinay Kolte ji's First Visit
sections.html:
Vinay Kolte ji's First Visit

We invited Vinay Kolte ji in early 2025 to check if things were fine. He appreciated our sincere efforts & results. His assurance for support raised our confidence.

sections.title: Training At The Nursery
sections.html:
Training At The Nursery

This year we took up the next challenge, & it was a nursery. We requested Vinay ji to train us with possible methods. Vinay ji was humble as ever to train us at his nursery in Bhor in March 2026. We came back with a mission & did exactly what he said.

sections.title: The Second Visit
sections.html:
The Second Visit

Yesterday Vinay ji visited the Oxygen Park the second time & he was more than impressed to see Bambusa Polymarpha saplings narrating the story of success themselves. He immediately took the phone & clicked a selfie with great smile & satisfaction. To celebrate the occasion, he said let's have a good tea Gaurav ji. We had 3 tea sessions dipped in long chat until we parted.

sections.title: Section 9
Section 10
sections.html:
A New Chapter

These saplings are a new chapter in our bamboo growth story.

Success tastes sweeter when it is the result of synergy. It becomes nectar when it's for benefit of others. Let's redefine the path of success in a divine way.
